actual_text: The castle candle was still missing. But tonight, a song was waiting beneath Rumi's pool.
I want to sing the first line. All by myself.
Then let's make that your turn.
What if my voice wobbles?
It can wobble. It's still yours. I'll be beside you, if you want.
